description:
modules/workforce — GET /traeger/staff-records/{id}/absence-accounts (#4710)
for a record with two Einsatzorte: the Träger's schools, the binding of the
Träger transaction, its release, the record with its links, the types, the
claims and the bookings at every Einsatzort in one statement each; then per
Einsatzort the binding of its tenant transaction, the access log entry and
its absence types. Flat in the number of types and bookings (ADR 0235).
